import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

public class mainF {
    public static Scanner enter = new Scanner(System.in);
    public static PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
    public static long mod = 998244353;
    public static long cnk[][] = new long[(int) 2e3 + 1][(int) 2e3 + 1];
    public static long fact[] = new long[2 * (int) 2e3 + 1];
    public static long reverse[] = new long[2 * (int) 2e3 + 1];
    public static long deg_2[] = new long[(int) 2e3 + 1];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        cnk[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < cnk.length; i++) {
            cnk[0][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                cnk[j][i] = cnk[j - 1][i - 1] + cnk[j][i - 1];
                cnk[j][i] %= mod;
            }
        }
        fact[0] = 1;
        deg_2[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < fact.length; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i;
            fact[i] %= mod;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < deg_2.length; i++) {
            deg_2[i] = deg_2[i - 1] * 2;
            deg_2[i] %= mod;
        }
        reverse[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 3; i < reverse.length; i += 2) {
            reverse[i] = bin_pow(fact[i], mod - 2, mod);
        }
        int n = enter.nextInt();
        int k = enter.nextInt();
        int l = enter.nextInt();
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = k; i <= n; i++) {
            final int iFinal = i;
            long tmp = IntStream.rangeClosed(0, n - i)
                .mapToLong(s -> {
                    long c = (s % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1;
                    long term = cnk[s][n - iFinal] * deg_2[s] % mod;
                    term = term * fact[s + iFinal] % mod;
                    term = term * fact[s + iFinal] % mod;
                    term = term * reverse[2 * (s + iFinal) + 1] % mod;
                    return term * c;
                })
                .reduce(0, (a, b) -> (a + b) % mod);
            ans += cnk[i][n] * deg_2[i] % mod * tmp % mod;
            ans %= mod;
        }
        ans *= l;
        ans %= mod;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    public static long bin_pow(long a, long b, long mod) {
        long ans = 1;
        while (b != 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) ans *= a;
            a *= a;
            ans %= mod;
            a %= mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }
}

        cnk[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < cnk.length; i++) {

        fact[0] = 1;
        deg_2[0] = 1;

        ans *= l;
        ans %= mod;
        System.out.println(ans);

    private static long computeTmp(int i, int n) {
        long tmp = 0;
        for (int s = 0, c = 1; s <= n - i; s++, c *= -1) {
            long term = cnk[s][n - i] * deg_2[s] % mod;
            term = term * fact[s + i] % mod;
            term = term * fact[s + i] % mod;
            term = term * reverse[2 * (s + i) + 1] % mod;
            tmp += term * c;
            tmp %= mod;

        return tmp;

    public static long bin_pow(long a, long b, long mod) {
        if (b == 0) return 1;
        long half = bin_pow(a, b / 2, mod);
        long result = half * half % mod;
        if (b % 2 == 1) result = result * a % mod;
        return result;
    }
